description: Rename, recolor, describe, move or reorder a label or group. Send only the fields to change. parentId null moves a label to the top level. An archived label cannot be edited (restore_label first), and a group cannot take a color or a parent. 409 means another active label under the same parent already has the name. Requires the labels update permission (every member by default). The change is recorded in your Speak Notifications under Label (type label).

description.description: New description (up to 500 characters, empty clears it)

parentId.description: labelId of a group to move into, or null for the top level

sortOrder.description: New position among its siblings (0 to 1000000)

name: update_label

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API
